purpose: One changed-condition Writer locator-retrieval retest plus a stable literal-formatting control; metadata-only fix, no new API, gate, full-189 run or promotion.

repair_hypothesis.description: The preserved native-reference usage retest completed 24 inspections without a mutation. Qwen explicitly wanted text.find, which was missing from its initial Top-K; tools_search was available but never used. Add only generic locator keywords to the existing Writer text.find catalog entry and one usage sentence to its owning description. No task parsing, default, constraint, execution, macro, or gate changes.
repair_hypothesis.expected_observable_change: Qwen selects the existing exact literal locator rather than repeatedly guessing paragraph indices, receives observed source/destination ranges, and independently composes native numbering, bookmark and cross-reference calls. Affected evaluator pass is the task-level objective; control 66 retains its literal-location/subscript pass. Locator use is a predefined partial behavior improvement, not a recovered pass.
repair_hypothesis.stop_signal: One fresh guest and one attempt per task with two workers. Stop at terminal outcomes, 100 global steps, 1800 seconds, existing no-progress/environment/transport/source limits or the 30-GiB disk stop. If the same unchanged read-only locator loop persists after soft restart, an engineering interruption may preserve the attempt as unscored. Keep source unchanged until both workers and supervisor exit; no unchanged replay.
repair_hypothesis.prior_attempt_disposition: Preserve Aug31 and Sep6 failures and the interrupted reference-usage pair. In that pair control 66 passed, while Order 79 was engineering-interrupted after 24 read-only events. Worker status interrupted was rejected by the existing supervisor as invalid_configuration; source/config final checks were ok. Do not count that interrupted episode or rewrite its raw classification.
repair_hypothesis.focused_verification: 182 native-reference, bounded-Writer, paragraph-spacing and Multi-Apps decomposition tests passed in 1.86 seconds; Ruff/diff checks pass. Five genuine pre-fix synthetic retrieval cases failed; an initial font-control expectation was corrected because that preexisting surface already included text.find. Current initial Top-K contains text.find for Order 79; Order 66 action list/order remains unchanged. Complete Writer schema excluding descriptions retains SHA-256 3a7a199c46c554486ca7d7d5e9a84f5e4a51fc0f24161c0cbbac27b637306768.
repair_hypothesis.decoding: Retain binary thinking, complete-call stop, 4096 Qwen output tokens and all previous endpoint/runtime budgets unchanged.
